question: If 5 eraser cost is Rs. 10. How much will 13 pencil cost?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

5 erasers cost ₹10

1 eraser cost = ₹2

13 erasers cost = 13 × 2 = ₹26

**∴ The correct answer is ₹26.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Cost of 5 erasers = ₹10

**Formula Used:**

Cost of 1 item = Total Cost ÷ Number of items

**Calculation:**

⇒ Cost of 1 eraser = 10 ÷ 5 = ₹2

⇒ Cost of 13 erasers = 13 × 2

⇒ Cost of 13 erasers = ₹26

**∴ The correct answer is ₹26.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Unitary Method

First find value of one unit, then multiply by required quantity.

Direct Proportion

If quantity increases, cost increases in same ratio.

Cost Formula

Total Cost = Number of items × Cost per item.
